nativeZh: n. 伊普尔（比利时西佛兰德省的一城市）

senses.en: battle in World War I (1917); an Allied offensive which eventually failed because tanks bogged down in the waterlogged soil of Flanders; Germans introduced mustard gas which interfered with the Allied artillery
senses.zh: 第一次世界大战(1917年)的战斗;盟军的一次进攻最终失败,因为坦克困在佛兰德斯被水淹没的土壤中;德国人引入了干扰盟军炮兵的芥子气.

senses.en: battle in World War I (1915); Germans wanted to try chlorine (a toxic yellow gas) as a weapon and succeeded in taking considerable territory from the Allied salient
senses.zh: 第一次世界大战(1915年)德国人想尝试氯(一种有毒的黄色气体)作为一种武器,并成功地从盟军的显著位置夺取了相当多的领土。

senses.en: battle in World War I (1914); heavy but indecisive fighting as the Allies and the Germans both tried to break through the lines of the others
senses.zh: 第一次世界大战(1914年)的战斗;作为盟军和德军都试图突破对方的防线的激烈但无决定力的战斗.
